result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with truncated restaurant name and a major content overflow issue in the restaurant listings sections.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated/cut off. The third card extends beyond the visible container width, causing text to be cut mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant name text wraps properly or implement ellipsis (...) if the name is too long. Adjust container width or card sizing so all content fits without horizontal overflow.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off at the screen bottom. The restaurant name, rating, and full details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing or card heights to ensure complete visibility of each restaurant card, or ensure proper scrolling allows users to see all content without having to scroll to view basic information like the restaurant name.
